sentences.text: The Mukhyamantri Swavalamban Yojana for Youth and Women in Business (MSYBC) is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India.
The scheme aims to promote self-employment among youth and women.
It seeks to provide financial assistance and support for starting small businesses.
The benefits include financial aid in the form of subsidies and loans.
Eligible beneficiaries include youth aged between 18 to 35 years and women entrepreneurs.
The application process involves submitting an online application along with required documents.
The timeline for processing applications is typically within a few weeks.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Micro Small and Medium Enterprises.
Additional details may include specific training programs for skill development.
